objective: Version continuity references and consent checks at attempt/attach

parts.part: YU-051 continuity references and per-stage consent

deviations: A take's lineage names the pack-version entries and identity encoding (id and payload hash) it was made with; a voice reference is project audio under voice-clone consent

record (story.save) needs references traceable only; attempt and attach (take.apply in its commit, story.assemble per selected take) also need present media and every consent usable now; an encoding is checked under its own consent
yamakan.continuity.check is advisory; metadata validity is reported apart from a continuity score that stays unmeasured
